standard settings.pilot air screw: 1-1/8 turns out (factory sets each vehicle individually; record factory turns before adjusting)

atmospheric conditions vs mixture.principle: air density (oxygen concentration) determines richness; higher temperature and higher humidity reduce density/oxygen; lower pressure at altitude reduces density

values.pilot air screw note: chart values are added to the ex-factory number of turns out

circuit ranges.pilot air screw: closed–1/8 throttle (turn in = richer, out = leaner)

values.jet needle note: main nozzle is press-fitted and cannot be replaced; tune with jet needle. 0.5 groove leaner than NYHW-2nd groove -> N3CW-1st groove; taper start change = 0.5 groove clip change
values.main jet by plug: plug too hot -> larger main jet; plug wet -> smaller main jet
values.spark plug heat range: if main jet must change by ±15, change spark plug heat range (never more than ±1 rank; resistance type) and reselect main jet

symptom-based examples.At full throttle: stall at high speeds,: increase main jet calibration no. gradually; if not corrected check float valve seat, fuel hose, fuel cock for clogging
symptom-based examples.At full throttle: speed pick-up stops, s: decrease main jet calibration no. gradually (slight enrichment reduces engine trouble when racing); check air filter, fuel overflow
symptom-based examples.1/4–3/4 throttle: hard breathing, lack o: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom-based examples.1/4–1/2 throttle: slow pick-up, white sm: raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up)
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: hard breathing,: use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: poor acceleratio: use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom-based examples.Unstable at low speeds, pinking noise: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down); turn in pilot air screw
symptom-based examples.Poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet calibration no.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse (check dragging brake, carburetor overflow)
symptom-based examples.Poor response in low to intermediate spe: raise jet needle clip position; if no effect reverse
symptom-based examples.Poor response when throttle opened quick: check overall settings; use lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse; check air filter fouling
symptom-based examples.Poor engine operation: turn in pilot air screw; check throttle valve operation
symptom-based examples.clip position numbering: grooves numbered from the top (groove 1 = top); clip lower = richer, higher = leaner
symptom-based examples.hard breathing note: in case of hard breathing check carburetor breather hoses for clogging

symptom-based suspension settings.shock: spongy and unstable: rebound ~2 clicks clockwise; low compression ~1 click clockwise; stiffer spring
symptom-based suspension settings.shock: poor road gripping: rebound ~2 clicks counterclockwise; low compression ~1 click clockwise; high compression ~1/6 turn clockwise; set sunken length 90–100 mm; softer spring
symptom-based suspension settings.shock: bottoming out: high compression ~1/6 turn clockwise; set sunken length 90–100 mm; stiffer spring
symptom-based suspension settings.shock: stiff travel: high compression ~1/6 turn counterclockwise; set sunken length 90–100 mm; softer spring
symptom-based suspension settings.spring change compensation (fork): soft spring: rebound out 1–2 clicks, compression in 1–2 clicks; stiff spring: rebound in 1–2 clicks, compression out 1–2 clicks
symptom-based suspension settings.spring change compensation (shock): soft spring: rebound 1–2 clicks out; stiff spring: rebound 1–2 clicks in; rebound changes also shift compression slightly
symptom-based suspension settings.fork oil amount adjustment: adjust in 5 cm³ (0.2 US oz, 0.2 Imp.oz) steps within the specified range; too little -> noise at full rebound; too much -> air spring too stiff

atmospheric conditions vs mixture.principle: air density (oxygen concentration) determines richness; higher temperature and higher humidity reduce density/oxygen; lower pressure at altitude reduces density

circuit ranges.pilot air screw: closed–1/8 throttle (turn in = richer, out = leaner)

values.main jet by plug: plug too hot -> larger main jet; plug wet -> smaller main jet
values.spark plug heat range: if main jet must change by ±15, change spark plug heat range (never more than ±1 rank; resistance type) and reselect main jet

symptom-based examples.At full throttle: stall at high speeds,: increase main jet calibration no. gradually; if not corrected check float valve seat, fuel hose, fuel cock for clogging
symptom-based examples.At full throttle: speed pick-up stops, s: decrease main jet calibration no. gradually (slight enrichment reduces engine trouble when racing); check air filter, fuel overflow
symptom-based examples.1/4–3/4 throttle: hard breathing, lack o: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom-based examples.1/4–1/2 throttle: slow pick-up, white sm: raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up)
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: hard breathing,: use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: poor acceleratio: use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom-based examples.Unstable at low speeds, pinking noise: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down); turn in pilot air screw
symptom-based examples.Poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet calibration no.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse (check dragging brake, carburetor overflow)
symptom-based examples.Poor response in low to intermediate spe: raise jet needle clip position; if no effect reverse
symptom-based examples.Poor response when throttle opened quick: check overall settings; use lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse; check air filter fouling
symptom-based examples.Poor engine operation: turn in pilot air screw; check throttle valve operation
symptom-based examples.clip position numbering: grooves numbered from the top (groove 1 = top); clip lower = richer, higher = leaner
symptom-based examples.hard breathing note: in case of hard breathing check carburetor breather hoses for clogging

atmospheric conditions vs mixture.principle: air density (oxygen concentration) determines richness; higher temperature and higher humidity reduce density/oxygen; lower pressure at altitude reduces density

values.main jet by plug: plug too hot -> larger main jet; plug wet -> smaller main jet
values.spark plug heat range: if main jet must change by ±15, change spark plug heat range (never more than ±1 rank; resistance type) and reselect main jet

symptom-based examples.At full throttle: stall at high speeds,: increase main jet calibration no. gradually; if not corrected check float valve seat, fuel hose, fuel cock for clogging
symptom-based examples.At full throttle: speed pick-up stops, s: decrease main jet calibration no. gradually (slight enrichment reduces engine trouble when racing); check air filter, fuel overflow
symptom-based examples.1/4–3/4 throttle: hard breathing, lack o: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down)
symptom-based examples.1/4–1/2 throttle: slow pick-up, white sm: raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up)
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: hard breathing,: use jet needle with smaller diameter
symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: poor acceleratio: use jet needle with larger diameter
symptom-based examples.Unstable at low speeds, pinking noise: lower jet needle clip position (1 groove down); turn in pilot air screw
symptom-based examples.Poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet calibration no.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse (check dragging brake, carburetor overflow)
symptom-based examples.Poor response in low to intermediate spe: raise jet needle clip position; if no effect reverse
symptom-based examples.Poor response when throttle opened quick: check overall settings; use lower main jet; raise clip 1 groove; if no effect reverse; check air filter fouling
symptom-based examples.Poor engine operation: turn in pilot air screw; check throttle valve operation
symptom-based examples.clip position numbering: grooves numbered from the top (groove 1 = top); clip lower = richer, higher = leaner
symptom-based examples.hard breathing note: in case of hard breathing check carburetor breather hoses for clogging

symptom-based examples.1/4–1/2 throttle: slow pick-up, white sm: raise jet needle clip position (1 groove up)

symptom-based examples.Closed to 1/4 throttle: poor acceleratio: use jet needle with larger diameter

symptom-based examples.Poor response at extremely low speed: reduce pilot jet calibration no.; turn out pilot air screw; if no effect reverse (check dragging brake, carburetor overflow)
symptom-based examples.Poor response in low to intermediate spe: raise jet needle clip position; if no effect reverse

symptom-based examples.Poor engine operation: turn in pilot air screw; check throttle valve operation
